blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Contact center systems often need to make bounded decisions, such as identifying a caller's intent, retrieving the knowledge-base article that answers a query, assessing agent compliance, or judging the output of AI models used in production. Decision models return a typed answer and its probability directly, making them a promising cost-effective alternative to generative Large Language Models (LLMs) in such bounded conversational tasks. However, their effectiveness in real-world contact center applications remains unclear. In this paper, we compare nine decision models against thirteen generative LLMs in zero-shot settings across eight contact center use cases: six classification tasks and two judging tasks. Our experiments demonstrate that many decision models can match the performance of frontier LLMs on contact center classification, and API-based closed decision models achieve this at the lowest per-request cost among the API models we evaluate. We further observe that their confident predictions are more accurate, enabling selective routing in real-world production scenarios. Across classification tasks, the main weakness of most decision models is abstention: they rarely choose the no-answer option, which accounts for most of their gap to the strongest LLMs (although Gemini-Decision-1 is the notable exception in this regard). We also find that the judging quality of decision models drops sharply for smaller models, and they are also more prone to position bias. In short, our findings provide practical guidance for selecting decision models based on abstention behavior, confidence, and deployment cost, rather than overall accuracy alone.
blocks.zh: 联系中心系统往往需要做出有约束的决定,例如确定呼叫者的意图,检索回答询问的知识基础文章,评估代理遵守,或者判断生产中使用的AI模型的输出. 决策模型直接返回一个打入的答案及其概率,使它们在这种有限度的对话任务中成为有希望的成本效益的替代基因大语言模型(LLMs). 然而,它们在现实世界联系中心应用中的有效性仍不明确. 在本文中,我们比较了9个决策模型和13个零镜头环境中的遗传性LLMs在8个联系中心使用的案例:6个分类任务和2个判断任务. 我们的实验表明,许多决策模型可以匹配联系中心分类方面的前沿有限责任模型的性能,基于API的封闭决策模型以我们评价的API模型中最低的按要求成本实现这一点. 我们进一步观察到,他们的自信预测更加准确,使得在现实世界的生产情景中能够有选择的路径。 在所有分类任务中,大多数决策模式的主要弱点是弃权:它们很少选择不回答选项,这占了它们大部分差距到最强的LLMs(尽管双子座-决定1是这方面的显著例外). 我们还发现,对于较小的模型来说,决定模型的判断质量急剧下降,它们也更容易出现位置偏差。 简言之,我们的调查结果为选择基于弃权行为、信心和部署成本的决策模式提供了实际指导,而不仅仅是总体准确性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to analyze business conversations, generate summaries, and power conversational agents ( Laskar et al., 2023b ; Fu et al., 2024 ; Laskar et al., 2025c ; Laskar et al., 2026a ) . Yet many contact center tasks require a bounded decision rather than a generated response. For instance, identifying a caller’s intent, checking whether a human agent followed a required procedure during a call, selecting the knowledge-base article that answers a customer’s question, or scoring the output of an AI model can be considered bounded decision tasks. More specifically, such tasks can only have a set of allowed answers. Applying an LLM to such decision tasks introduces substantial inference cost ( Li et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)越来越多地用于分析商业对话、生成摘要和权力对话代理人(Laskar等人,2023b); Fu等人,2024年;Laskar等人,2025年c;Laskar等人,2026年a) 然而,许多联系中心的任务需要作出有限度的决定,而不是得到回应。 例如,确定打电话者的意图,检查一名人类代理人在电话通话时是否遵循了必要的程序,选择回答客户问题的知识基础文章,或评分AI模型的输出,都可以视为有限度的决定任务. 更具体地说,这种任务只能有一套允许的答案. 对这类决定任务采用LLM会产生大量推论成本(Li等人,2026年b)。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of the evaluation. Decision models and generative LLMs answer the same instances zero-shot.
blocks.zh: 图1:评价概览。 决策模型和遗传性LLMS回答同样的例子零镜头.

blocks.en: To tackle this, decision models offer an alternative cost-effective interface. Given a context, a question, and the allowed answer options, they return a typed decision together with a probability for each option ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ; Cloudflare, 2026 ; Google, 2026b ; OpenAI, 2026b ) . Unlike encoder classifiers such as BERT ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) , decision models demonstrate strong performance in zero-shot settings, without task-specific training data. This makes them attractive for real-world contact center applications, where training data construction is not trivial since label sets may differ across customers Dong et al. (2021) ; Parikh et al. (2023) ; Pattnaik et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 为解决这一问题,决策模式提供了一个成本效益高的替代界面。 考虑到一个上下文,一个问题,以及允许的答案选项,他们返回一个打字的决定以及每个选项的概率(TypeSafe AI,2026;Cloudflare,2026;Google,2026b;OpenAI,2026b). 与编码器分类器如BERT(Devlin等人,2019年)不同,决策模型在零镜头设置中表现出强效性能,没有特定任务的培训数据. 这使得它们对于现实世界的联络中心应用具有吸引力,因为培训数据构建并非微不足道,因为客户的标签集可能不同 Dong等人(2021年);Parikh等人(2023年);Pattnaik等人(2025年)。

blocks.en: In this paper, we investigate whether zero-shot decision models can replace generative LLMs for contact center decision problems, i.e., tasks that do not necessarily require free-form text generation. We compare nine decision models with thirteen generative LLMs on six classification and two judging tasks (Figure 1 ). Our major contributions: • We conduct a comprehensive zero-shot evaluation of decision models and generative LLMs on eight real-world contact center tasks, covering classification tasks to model judging. • We show that most decision models rarely choose the no-answer option, which accounts for most of their gap to the strongest LLMs. • We find that judge quality depends on the task and metric: decision models align well with frontier LLM judges on pointwise ratings, but poorly on pairwise preference, where they also show strong position bias. • We further analyze model confidence and find that confident predictions are more accurate.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们调查零镜头决定模型是否可以取代基因LLMs用于联系中心决策问题,即不一定需要自由格式文本生成的任务. 我们比较了9个决策模型和13个关于6个分类和2个判断任务的遗传性有限责任模型(图1)。 • 我们的主要贡献: 我们就8项现实世界联系中心任务对决策模型和遗传性LLMs进行全面的零镜头评价,涵盖用于模型判断的分类任务。 我们显示,大多数决策模式很少选择不回答选项,这占了它们大部分的空白,属于最强的有限责任公司。 我们认为,法官的素质取决于任务和衡量标准:判决模式与前沿LLM法官的分级一致,但不太符合双向偏好,他们也表现出强烈的立场偏差。 我们进一步分析模型自信,发现自信预测更准确.

blocks.en: We conduct a comprehensive zero-shot evaluation of decision models and generative LLMs on eight real-world contact center tasks, covering classification tasks to model judging.
blocks.zh: 我们对决策模型和遗传性LLMs对8项现实世界联系中心任务进行全面的零镜头评价,涵盖用于模型判断的分类任务.

blocks.en: We show that most decision models rarely choose the no-answer option, which accounts for most of their gap to the strongest LLMs.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,大多数决策模式很少选择无答案选项,这占了它们的大部分差距,而其中最强的LLM.

blocks.en: We find that judge quality depends on the task and metric: decision models align well with frontier LLM judges on pointwise ratings, but poorly on pairwise preference, where they also show strong position bias.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,法官的质量取决于任务和衡量标准:判决模式与前沿LLM法官的评分完全一致,但不太符合对等偏好,他们也表现出强烈的立场偏见。

blocks.en: We further analyze model confidence and find that confident predictions are more accurate.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步分析模型自信,发现自信预测更准确.

blocks.zh: 表1:评价任务。 质量保证和程序 台阶中分别包含1,036和2,938个得分的提问.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Zero-shot text classification uses task descriptions to predict labels without target-task training ( Yin et al., 2019 ; Laskar et al., 2023a ) . Decision models extend this setting with typed outputs and native probability distributions ( Cloudflare, 2026 ; OpenJev Contributors, 2026 ) . Recent work studies confidence-based escalation when JEV is used as a judge ( Li et al., 2026b ) and delegation between decision models and LLM agents ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . However, prior work mostly evaluates decision models on public academic benchmarks, where zero-shot results are exposed to data contamination ( Li et al., 2026a ; Deußer et al., 2026 ) . We instead examine them on proprietary real-world contact center datasets.
blocks.zh: 0shot文本分类法使用任务描述来预测没有目标任务训练的标签(Yin等人,2019;Laskar等人,2023a). 决策模型以输入输出和本地概率分布来扩展这一设置(Cloudflare, 2026;OpenJev贡献者, 2026). 近期的工作研究了在JEV被用作法官(Li等人,2026年b)和决定模型与LLM代理人(Zhu等人,2026年b)之间的授权时,基于信任的升级. 然而,先前的工作主要评价关于公共学术基准的决策模式,其中零射结果暴露于数据污染(Li等人,2026a); Deußer等人,2026年). 我们用专有的真人联系中心数据集来检查它们。

blocks.en: Another important use case of decision models is to use them as the judge to evaluate different AI models’ generated responses Li et al. (2026b) . However, prior work demonstrates that smaller, cost-effective LLM judges fail to match human assessments ( Fu et al., 2023 ) , require task-specific adaptation ( Laskar et al., 2025b ) , and are prone to position bias ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Laskar et al., 2025a ) . We therefore evaluate decision-model judges on both their agreement with reference judgments and biases in verdicts.
blocks.zh: 决策模型的另一个重要用途是用它们作为法官来评价不同AI模型产生的响应Li等人(2026年b). 然而,以往的研究表明,规模较小、成本效益高的LLM法官不能与人类评估相匹配(Fu等人,2023年),需要根据具体任务进行调整(Laskar等人,2025年b),而且容易出现职位偏差(Zheng等人,2023年;Wang等人,2024年;Laskar等人,2025年a)。 因此,我们评价裁判模式法官是否同意参考判决和判决中的偏颇。

blocks.en: 3 Tasks and Data
blocks.zh: 3 任务和数据

blocks.en: We collect real-world data from Dialpad 1 1 1 https://www.dialpad.com/ , covering customer–agent call conversation transcripts, retrieved documents for assisting agents, and AI-generated responses. We organize it into six classification tasks and two judging tasks (see Table 1 and Figure 1 ). Below, we describe each task.
blocks.zh: 我们从Dialpad 11 1 https://www.dialpad.com/收集真实世界的数据,涵盖客户-代理通话记录、为协助人员检索文件以及AI生成的答复。 我们将其分为六个分类任务和两个判断任务(见表1和图1)。 下面,我们描述每一项任务。

blocks.en: 3.1 Classification Tasks
blocks.zh: 3.1 分类任务

blocks.en: Given a customer–agent call transcript, Call Outcome asks for the result of the call (e.g., issue resolved, transferred), while Purpose of Call asks for the customer’s reason for calling (e.g., billing questions). Both tasks require the selection of one label from 30 fixed labels (different set of labels for each task).
blocks.zh: 鉴于客户-代理电话记录,Call Entertainment询问电话结果(例如,问题解决、转移),而Call目的则询问客户打电话的理由(例如,账单问题)。 这两项任务都需要从30个固定标签中选择一个标签(每个任务不同的标签集).

blocks.en: Both tasks answer Yes/No questions about a transcript. Quality Assurance asks whether the call satisfies a service-quality criterion (1–10 questions per conversation). Procedural Step asks whether the agent carried out a specific step, such as verifying the caller’s identity (2–20 questions per conversation).
blocks.zh: 这两项任务都回答关于记录的“是/否”问题。 质量 保证会询问电话是否符合服务质量标准(每次交谈1至10个问题)。 程序性 步骤询问代理人是否采取了特定步骤,例如核实打电话者的身份(每次谈话2-20个问题)。

blocks.en: We evaluate whether models can correctly classify the intent of the customer utterance. Unlike call outcome and purpose of call, where 30 fixed labels are always provided, the candidate labels in intent classification are dynamically provided in the input, ranging from 4 to 21 options.
blocks.zh: 我们评价模型是否能够正确划分客户言论的意图。 与调用结果和目的不同,总提供30个固定标签,意向分类中的候选人标签在输入中动态提供,从4到21个选项不等.

blocks.en: Given a conversation and three knowledge-base articles, this task evaluates whether models can select the most relevant article that can answer the customer’s question, or − 1 -1 if none does.
blocks.zh: 考虑到一次谈话和三篇基于知识的文章,这项任务评价模型是否能够选择最相关的文章来回答客户的问题,或者如果没有的话——1-1.

blocks.en: 3.2 Judging Tasks
blocks.zh: 3.2 判断任务

blocks.en: This dataset contains customer-agent conversations where the LLM agent is required to resolve a support issue by following a skill workflow Laskar et al. (2026b) . The judge receives the instructions, policies, conversation turns, and tool call logs. It returns a five-way task-completion verdict (success, failure, partial, appropriately transferred, or appropriately detecting out of scope), a yes/no verdict for hallucinated actions, and five 1–5 rubric ratings for the following criteria: workflow adherence, tool-use correctness, guardrail compliance, communication quality, and resolution efficiency. An overall pass verdict is then derived by a fixed rule rather than asked directly: a conversation passes if the task completion is a success or an appropriate transfer or out-of-scope verdict, workflow adherence is at least 4, no hallucinated action is found.
blocks.zh: 该数据集包含客户-代理人对话,其中LLM代理通过遵循技能工作流程Laskar等人(2026b)来解决支持问题. 法官接受指示、政策、谈话和工具呼叫记录。 它返回了五条任务完成判决(成功、失败、部分、适当转移或适当检测范围外)、对幻觉行动的判决是/否、对下列标准的5个1至5项评级:工作流程遵守、工具使用正确性、守备合规、通信质量和分辨率效率。 然后通过固定规则而不是直接要求得出总体通过判决:如果任务完成成功或适当的转移或范围外的判决,对话通过,工作流程遵守至少4,没有发现幻觉行动。

blocks.en: Judges evaluate summaries and action items generated by two models, Qwen-3.5-9B Qwen Team (2026a) and Qwen-3.8-27B Qwen Team (2026c) . We evaluate the responses using both pointwise and pairwise metrics. For pointwise, each response is rated from 1 to 5 for faithfulness, completeness, and instruction following. For pairwise, the judge chooses the better response, or a tie. To measure position bias, each pair is shown in both orders.
blocks.zh: 法官评价Quen-3.5-9B Quen Team(2026a)和Quen-3.8-27B两种模式产生的摘要和行动项目 Quen Team (2026c) (英语). 我们使用对准和对准的衡量尺度来评估这些反应。 从点上看,每一份答复的忠诚度、完整性和随后的指示等级从1到5。 对于对偶,法官会选择更好的反应,或者一个平局. 为了测量位置偏差,每对在两种顺序中都显示.

blocks.en: Table 2: Accuracy (%) on the six classification tasks; Avg. is the unweighted mean.
blocks.zh: 表2:6分类任务的精确度(%);Avg.是未加权的平均值.

Pointwise : mean Spearman’s ρ \rho across faithfulness, completeness, and instruction-following ratings of generated responses; Pairwise : Cohen’s κ \kappa on preference verdicts; Agent Workflow Avg. : the average of seven scores: Cohen’s κ \kappa for pass and task-completion verdicts and Spearman’s ρ \rho for each of the five rubric ratings. blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate nine decision models: the API-based closed JEV 1.13 ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) , Gemini-Decision-1 ( Google, 2026b ) and GPT-6-Luna-Decisions ( OpenAI, 2026b ) ; the open-weight Clef ( Cloudflare, 2026 ) and OpenJev ( OpenJev Contributors, 2026 ) (27B) and their 9B Flash variants; lev and Kev ( Palmer, 2026 ) (4B). The generative baselines comprise eight open LLMs covering Qwen ( Qwen Team, 2026a ; Qwen Team, 2026b ; Qwen Team, 2026c ) and Gemma ( Gemma Team, 2025 ; Gemma Team, 2026 ) series models and five cost-effective API models: GPT-5.6-Luna ( OpenAI, 2026c ) , GPT-6-Luna ( OpenAI, 2026d ) , Gemini-3.8-Flash ( Doshi and Popa, 2026 ) , Gemini-3.5-Flash-Lite ( Google, 2026a ) , and Claude-Haiku-5.5 ( Anthropic, 2026b ) . We use two reference judges from two model families: GPT-6.1-Sol ( OpenAI, 2026a ) (primary) and Claude-Sonnet-5.5 ( Anthropic, 2026a ) .
blocks.zh: 我们评价了9个决策模型:基于API的闭合JEV 1.13(TypeSafe AI, 2026),双子座决定-1(Google, 2026b)和GPT-6-Luna-决定(OpenAI, 2026b);开放重量的Clef(Cloudflare, 2026)和OpenJev(OpenJev Controductions, 2026)及其9B Flash的变体;lev和Kev(Palmer, 2026) (4B). 基因基线包括8个开放式LLMs,涵盖Quen(Quen Team,2026a;Quen Team,2026b;Quen Team,2026c)和Gemma(Gemma Team,2025;Gemma Team,2026)系列模型和5个成本效益高的API模型:GPT-5.6-Luna(OpenAI,2026c),GPT-6-Luna(OpenAI,2026d),双子座-3.8-Flash(Doshi和Popa,2026),双子座3.5-Flash-Lite. (Google, 2026a),和克劳德-海库-5.5 (Anthropic, 2026b). 我们用两个模范家庭的两位参考法官: GPT-6.1-Sol(OpenAI, 2026a)(主)和克劳德-索内特-5.5(Anthropic, 2026a). 。 。 。

blocks.en: An evaluation instance is a triplet ( x , q , 𝒴 ) (x,q,\mathcal{Y}) : the task context x x , a question q q , and the allowed answers 𝒴 \mathcal{Y} . All models are evaluated zero-shot, without any fine-tuning or few-shot demonstrations. Descriptions of the candidate labels are also provided where applicable (i.e., call outcome, purpose of call, intent classification). Decision models receive 𝒴 \mathcal{Y} as typed options and return an answer with option probabilities, while generative LLMs return the answer as structured output. Appendix C shows prompt templates for all tasks.
blocks.zh: 评价实例是三重(x, q, Y) (x, q,\ mathcal{Y}) : 任务上下文 x, a question q q, 和允许的答案 Y\ mathcal{Y}。 所有模型均被评价为零射,没有任何微调或几发演示. 在适用的情况下,还提供候选人标签的说明(即呼叫结果、呼叫目的、意图分类)。 决策模型接收 Y\ mathcal{Y} 作为键入选项并返回一个有选项概率的答案,而基因LLMs 则返回作为结构输出的答案. 附 录 C 显示所有任务的快速模板 。

blocks.en: For classification, we report exact match accuracy by comparing the model-selected label with the gold label. For judging, we follow prior work that evaluates cheap smaller judges by comparing against a stronger one ( Laskar et al., 2025a ) . Here, we use GPT-6.1-Sol and Claude-Sonnet-5.5 as reference judges and measure correlation between our evaluated models and reference judges in terms Cohen’s κ \kappa for categorical verdicts and Spearman’s ρ \rho for 1–5 ratings.
blocks.zh: 对于分类,我们通过比较模型选择的标签和金色标签来报告准确的匹配准确性. 为了判断,我们遵循先前的工作,即通过比较一个更强大的法官来评价廉价的较小的法官(Laskar等人,2025a)。 在这里,我们使用GPT-6.1-Sol和Claude-Sonnet-5.5作为参考法官,并用科恩的“ob kappa”和斯皮尔曼的1–5评分来衡量我们评估的模式和参考法官之间的关联。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Classification Tasks
blocks.zh: 5.1 分类任务

blocks.en: Table 2 shows that Qwen-3.8-27B achieves the highest average accuracy across the six classification tasks (78.6), followed by Gemini-3.8-Flash (77.4) and Gemini-Decision-1 (76.2). Beyond the top two models, performance is closely clustered: the nine models ranked third to eleventh differ by only 2.3 percentage points. Thus, although the strongest generative models lead overall, the performance of several decision models is also comparable to the generative LLMs.
blocks.zh: 表2显示,Quen-3.8-27B在六项分类任务(78.6)中的平均准确度最高,其次是双子座-3.8-Flash(77.4)和双子座-1(76.2)。 在前两种模式之外,性能被紧密地分组:9种模式排名第三至第11位,只差2.3个百分点. 因此,虽然最强的基因模型总体上领先,但若干决策模型的性能也与基因模型LLMS相当.

blocks.en: Gemini-Decision-1 is the strongest decision model (76.2), followed by OpenJev and GPT-6-Luna-Decisions (both 75.9), JEV (75.5), and Clef (73.6). These leading decision models also outperform many generative LLMs, indicating that free-form generation is not necessary for strong performance on these bounded classification tasks. Among open-weight decision models, larger variants generally achieve higher accuracy. However, performance differences remain pronounced on Intent classification and RAG document selection. Averaged over these two tasks, OpenJev (76.1), JEV (73.5), and Clef (69.3) trail Qwen-3.8-27B (82.2) and Gemini-3.8-Flash (81.2). Gemini-Decision-1 achieves 78.7, narrowing this gap and showing that the weakness is not shared equally across decision models.
blocks.zh: 双子座决定1是最强的决定模式(76.2),其次是OpenJev和GPT-6-Luna-决定(均为75.9),JEV(75.5)和Clef(73.6). 这些主要决策模型也超越了许多遗传性LLMs,表明自由形式生成对于这些受约束的分类任务的强效表现是不必要的. 在开放量级决策模型中,较大的变体一般能达到更高的精度. 然而,在意向分类和RAG文件选择方面,业绩差异仍然明显。 平均完成这两项任务,OpenJev(76.1),JEV(73.5)和Clef(69.3)小径Quen-3.8-27B(82.2)和双子座-3.8-Flash(81.2). 双子座-决定1实现了78.7,缩小了这一差距,并表明在决策模式中,这一弱点并没有得到平等分享。

blocks.en: Call Outcome is the hardest task for all models (best: 55.2), whereas the strongest models reach 86–88% in Quality Assurance and Procedural Step. Accuracy increases with size within each family: moving from 9B to 27B adds 4.8 points for OpenJev and 3.3 for Clef.
blocks.zh: “呼叫结果”是所有模型最艰巨的任务(最佳:55.2),而最强模型在质量保证和程序性步骤中达到86-88%。 准确度随着每个家族内部的大小增加:从9B升至27B为OpenJev增加了4.8分,克莱夫增加了3.3分.

blocks.en: 5.2 Judging Tasks
blocks.zh: 5.2 判断任务

blocks.en: Gemini-3.8-Flash has the highest overall agreement (0.60), followed by GPT-5.6-Luna (0.59) and GPT-6-Luna (0.58). Meanwhile, Qwen-3.8-27B, which is the strongest classifier, reaches only 0.52.
blocks.zh: 双子座-3.8-Flash的总协议最高(0.60),其次是GPT-5.6-Luna(0.59)和GPT-6-Luna(0.58). 同时,作为最强分类器的Quen-3.8-27B只达到0.52.

blocks.en: GPT-6-Luna-Decisions leads among decision models (overall 0.52), followed by JEV (0.51) and Clef (0.48); Gemini-Decision-1 reaches only 0.42 despite leading decision-model across classification tasks. For the four strongest decision models, generated-response pointwise correlations range from 0.44 to 0.60, but pairwise κ \kappa ranges from 0.19 to 0.39.
blocks.zh: GPT-6-Luna-决定在决定模式中居领先地位(总体为0.52),其次是JEV(0.51)和Clef(0.48);双子座决定1尽管在整个分类任务中都领先决定模式,但只达到0.42。 对于四个最强的决策模型,生成的点对点相关性从0.44到0.60不等,但双对点对点为0.19到0.39不等。

blocks.en: The judge rankings are nearly unchanged across references (Spearman ρ = 0.99 \rho=0.99 ). Gemini-3.8-Flash leads under GPT-6.1-Sol (0.65), followed by GPT-5.6-Luna (0.63) and GPT-6-Luna (0.60). Under Claude-Sonnet-5.5, GPT-5.6-Luna and GPT-6-Luna lead (both 0.56), followed by Gemini-3.8-Flash (0.55). This pattern suggests that same-family preference is not a major driver of the overall rankings: the GPT judges remain competitive under the Claude reference, while the Gemini judge leads under the GPT reference.
blocks.zh: 法官的排名在参考文献中几乎保持不变(Spearman ^ = 0.99\rho= 0.99)。 双子座-3.8-Flash领先于GPT-6.1-Sol(0.65),其次是GPT-5.6-Luna(0.63)和GPT-6-Luna(0.60). Claude-Sonnet-5.5,GPT-5.6-Luna和GPT-6-Luna领先(均为0.56),之后是双子座-3.8-Flash(0.55). 这种模式表明,同一家庭偏好并不是总体排名的主要驱动力:GPT法官在克劳德参照下保持竞争力,而双子座法官则在GPT参照下领先.

blocks.en: Judging is more sensitive to scale than classification. Against GPT-6.1-Sol, the 9B decision models retain less than half the average agreement of their 27B counterparts: 0.18 vs. 0.45 for Clef and 0.14 vs. 0.43 for OpenJev. The 4B models perform even worse (Kev 0.10, lev 0.05).

blocks.en: 5.3 Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.3 分析

blocks.en: Across the 22 models, rankings of models between classification and judging are strongly but not perfectly correlated (Spearman ρ = 0.85 \rho={0.85} ). Notably, GPT-5.6-Luna rises from tenth as a classifier to second as a judge, whereas Gemini-Decision-1 drops from third to tenth. Strong performance in classification therefore does not imply similar performance in judging.
blocks.zh: 在22个模型中,分类和判断之间的模型排名有很强但并非完全的关联性(Spearman ^ = 0.85\rho\\0.85})。 值得注意的是,GPT-5.6-Luna作为法官从第十级上升到第二级,而双子座决定-1则从第三名下降到第十级。 因此,严格分类并不意味着在判断方面有类似的业绩。

blocks.en: The largest source of error for most decision models is a reluctance to choose the no-answer option (see Table 4 ). On Intent, OpenJev (92.2%) and JEV (92.1%) are the most accurate of all models on requests that match a configured intent, above Gemini-3.8-Flash and Qwen-3.8-27B (both 86.4%). However, eight of the nine decision models in Table 2 could correctly classify only 6–27% of no intent requests, compared with 85% for Gemini-3.8-Flash and 81% for Qwen-3.8-27B. Gemini-Decision-1 is the exception: it correctly classifies 86.8% of no intent requests. RAG document selection shows the same pattern. When a relevant article exists, JEV, OpenJev, and Clef correctly select an acceptable one in 82–86% of cases, above Qwen-3.8-27B (80.3%) and Gemini-3.8-Flash (77.7%). When none is relevant, they answer “none” in only 26–49% of cases, compared with 77% and 74% for the respective LLMs. Some LLMs share this failure (e.g., 28% for GPT-5.6-Luna), and some smaller LLMs almost never abstain (e.g., Gemma-3-4B, Qwen-3.5-2B).
blocks.zh: 大多数决策模式的最大错误来源是不愿选择不回答方案(见表4)。 在意向上,OpenJev(92.2%)和JEV(92.1%)是符合配置意向的所有请求中最准确的,高于双子座-3.8-Flash和Quen-3.8-27B(均为86.4%). 然而,在表2的9个决定模型中,只有8个可以正确划分无意向请求的6-27%,而双子座-3.8-Flash和Quen-3.8-27B的这一比例分别为85%和81%。 双子座-决定1是例外:它正确分类了86.8%的无意向请求. RAG文档选择显示相同的模式. 当存在相关文章时,JEV,OpenJev和Clef在82-86%的案例中正确选择了可接受的文章,高于Quen-3.8-27B(80.3%)和双子座-3.8-Flash(77.7%). 在没有相关的情况下,它们只回答26-49%的个案的 " 无 " 问题,而相应的有限责任公司则回答77%和74%。 一些LLMs分享了这一失败(例如GPT-5.6-Luna的28%),一些较小的LLMs几乎从未弃权(例如Gemma-3-4B,Quen-3.5-2B).

blocks.en:
Decision models return a probability p p for the selected option. Across six classification tasks, confidence predicts correctness with AUROC Hanley and McNeil (1982) 0.69–0.92 for the seven decision models of at least 9B or accessed through APIs. Figure 2 shows accuracy when confidence is at p ≥ 0.9 p\geq 0.9 for the five best decision models. On Intent, JEV achieves 97.1% accuracy at p ≥ 0.9 p\geq 0.9 , compared with 78.7% overall. At p ≥ 0.9 p\geq 0.9 , Gemini-Decision-1 reaches 99.6%. On Quality Assurance and Procedural Step, JEV, OpenJev, and Clef achieve 91–96% accuracy at p ≥ 0.9 p\geq 0.9 . These results support accepting confident predictions and routing the remainder to a stronger model.
However, confidence has two limitations. Confidence coverage with p ≥ 0.9 p\geq 0.9 varies by task: on Call Outcome, it is only 14–28% for JEV, OpenJev, Clef, and Gemini-Decision-1; GPT-6-Luna-Decisions reaches 44% coverage but only 75% accuracy. Confident errors also persist when abstention is required: 12 of JEV’s 14 confident Intent errors assign an intent to no intent requests.

决策模型返回选定选项的概率p。 在六个分类任务中,信心预测了AUROC Hanley和McNeil(1982年)至少9B或通过API访问的七个决定模型的正确性。 图2显示五个最佳决策模型的置信度为0.9 p\geq 0.9。 在意向方面,JEV在0.9 p\geq 0.9 p\geq 0.9的精度达到97.1%,而总体为78.7%。 第0.9页,双子座决定1达到99.6%。 关于质量保证和程序性步骤,JEV、OpenJev和Clef在p 0.9 p\geq实现91-96%的精确度 0.9 (英语). 这些结果有助于接受自信的预测,并引导其余部分采用更强有力的模式。
然而,信心有两个限制。 0.9 p\ geq 0.9页的信心覆盖面因任务而异:在呼叫结果中,JEV、OpenJev、Clef和双子座决定1的可信度仅为14-28%;GPT-6-Luna-决定的覆盖面为44%,但准确度仅为75%。 当需要弃权时,令人信服的错误也依然存在:在JEV的14个自信的意向错误中,有12个无意请求。

blocks.en: We test five leading pairwise judges for position bias, defined as selecting the same displayed position after reversing response order (Table 5 ). JEV selects the second position in both orders for 24.6% of pairs, versus 7.2% for GPT-6-Luna and 1.5% for Gemini-3.8-Flash. Conversely, GPT-6-Luna-Decisions and Gemini-Decision-1 favor the first position for 45.6% and 26.1% of pairs, consistently selecting the same response across orders in only 48.9% and 56.1%. We also find that high confidence ( p ≥ 0.9 p\geq 0.9 ) weakly predicts judging correctness: pairwise-preference AUROC is only 0.57–0.66 for JEV, OpenJev, and Clef.

blocks.en: 6 Cost and Deployment Guidance
blocks.zh: 6 费用和部署指导

Local models use one NVIDIA A100 GPU (p50: median latency), and therefore no usage cost is reported; API costs use recorded usage and list prices of November 2026; the API-based closed decision models (JEV, Gemini-Decision-1, GPT-6-Luna-Decisions) do not bill output tokens. blocks.en: JEV is the cheapest measured judge at $0.10 per 1,000 judgments, versus $0.22 for Gemini-Decision-1, $0.25 for GPT-6-Luna-Decisions, $0.32 for GPT-6-Luna, and $2.00 for Gemini-3.8-Flash. However, its κ \kappa is lower than those of the two generative models (0.38 vs. 0.56 and 0.64). For classification, the three decision APIs cost $0.09–0.23 per 1,000 requests, with similar or higher accuracy than GPT-6-Luna, the cheapest generative API at $0.29. Among open-weight models (benchmarked on one A100 GPU), 9B decision models are the fastest (median 0.4 s), but 27B models are 3–4x slower.
blocks.zh: JEV是衡量得最便宜的法官,每1 000项判决为0.10美元,对双子座-决定-1为0.22美元,对GPT-6-Luna-决定为0.25美元,对GPT-6-Luna为0.32美元,对双子座-3.8-Flash为2.00美元。 然而,它的κ-kappa(0.38对0.56和0.64)低于两个基因模型。 就分类而言,三项决定的API费用为每1,000项请求0.09-0.23美元,准确度与GPT-6-Luna相似或更高,后者是最便宜的基因性API,为0.29美元。 在开放量级模型(以一个A100 GPU为基准)中,9B决策模型最快(中间0.4 s),但27B模型慢3–4x.

blocks.en: Before deployment, (1) evaluate classification and judging separately; (2) measure no-answer recall; (3) calibrate confidence thresholds for classification routing; (4) validate pointwise and workflow verdicts; and (5) evaluate pairwise comparisons in both orders.
blocks.zh: 在部署前, (1) 分别评价分类和判断; (2) 测量无答回溯; (3) 校准分类路由的置信阈值; (4) 验证点和工作流程判断; (5) 在两个订单中评价对等比较.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We evaluated nine decision models and thirteen generative LLMs on eight real-world contact center tasks. Many decision models can match frontier LLM performance on call classification, are competitive judges of multi-turn agent workflows, and expose confidence scores that enable selective routing; API-based closed decision models also have the lowest per-request cost among the API models we evaluated. However, most rarely abstain on unsupported intents and irrelevant documents, judge pairwise preferences poorly and with position bias, and lose most of their judging quality at smaller scale. Model selection should therefore rely on abstention tests, judge agreement, confidence audits, and measured cost alongside overall accuracy. Future work will further study calibrated abstention thresholds and evaluate across more tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了9个决策模型和13个遗传性LLMs,涉及8个现实世界联系中心的任务。 许多决定模型可以在呼叫分类上匹配前沿LLM性能,是多回合代理工作流程的竞争性判断者,并暴露出能够选择路由的置信分数;基于API的闭合决定模型,在我们评价的API模型中,每个请求成本也最低. 然而,大多数国家很少对无支持的意图和无关的文件投弃权票,对双向偏好的评价不佳,立场偏偏,在较小的尺度上失去了大部分判断质量。 因此,模型选择应依靠弃权测试、法官同意、信任审计和衡量成本以及总体准确性。 今后的工作将进一步研究经过校准的弃权门槛,并对更多的任务进行评价。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Our study is offline and measures no live customer outcomes. The four call-level tasks use stored operational labels whose annotation process is undocumented, and the Intent utterances are synthetic.
The confidence analysis is retrospective and uses a fixed threshold. Generalization to other settings, organizations, languages, and future model versions remains untested.
blocks.zh:
我们的研究离线了 无法衡量客户的现场结果 四个调用级别的任务使用存储的操作标签,其注释过程没有记录,意向语是合成的.
信心分析具有追溯性,采用固定阈值. 对其他环境、组织、语言和未来模式版本的概括仍未经过测试。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: Incorrect contact center decisions can misroute customers, overlook procedure failures, or pass irrelevant evidence to an answer generator. We therefore report abstention recall and confident errors, because aggregate accuracy can hide these risks, and we recommend human review before consequential use. The data come from private contact center customer interactions that are PII-redacted. Licensing requirements are followed accordingly for the evaluated models.
blocks.zh: 不正确的联系中心决定可能会误导客户,忽略程序故障,或者将无关的证据传递给一个解答生成器. 因此,我们报告投弃权票和信心错误,因为总的准确性可以掩盖这些风险,我们建议先进行人的审查,然后再使用。 数据来自私人联系中心客户互动,这些互动由PII编辑. 所评价的模型相应遵循许可证要求。

blocks.zh: 表10:以GPT-6.1-Sol作为参考判断的模型生成的响应:原始协议,签名偏差(candidate 减去参考评级),MAE在三个评级维度之上,一分之内(W-1)的评级百分比,以及有效点心输出的百分比. 对等和准确的协议是百分比。

blocks.en: Table 11: Agent workflow judging against GPT-6.1-Sol on 8,600 conversations: raw agreement (%) on the pass and task-completion verdicts, Spearman ρ \rho per rubric dimension, MAE and within-one agreement (W-1, %) over the five dimensions, and percentage of conversations with a valid output.
blocks.zh: 表11:针对GPT-6.1-Sol的8 600个对话的代理工作流程判断:关于通过和任务完成判决的原始协议(%)、Spearman ^ \rho / rric 维度、MAE和5个维度的内协议(W-1,%)以及有效产出的对话百分比。

blocks.en: Appendix C Per Task Sample Prompt
blocks.zh: 附录C 任务样本提示

blocks.en: Each evaluation instance consists of a context (e.g., conversation transcript), one or more questions, and the allowed answers for each question (Section 4 ). Because the tasks come from production contact center workflows, the boxes below show generic templates rather than the exact prompts used in production. Decision models receive each question with its typed answer options; generative LLMs receive the same content together with the output instruction in the last box.
blocks.zh: 每个评价实例包括上下文(例如谈话记录)、一个或多个问题,以及每个问题的允许答案(第4节)。 由于任务来自生产接触中心的工作流程,下面的框显示的是通用模板,而不是生产中使用的确切提示. 决策模型接收每个问题时都有其打出的答案选项;基因LLMs与最后一个框中的输出指令得到相同的内容.

blocks.en: Call Outcome CONTEXT {call transcript} QUESTION Which label best describes the outcome of this call? POSSIBLE ANSWERS One of a fixed set of outcome labels with short descriptions (e.g., issue resolved, transferred).
blocks.zh: 调用结果背景 [呼叫记录] 问题 哪个标签最能描述这个电话的结果? 可能的回答 一套固定的结果标签,有简短的说明(如问题解决,转移).

blocks.en: Purpose of Call CONTEXT {call transcript} QUESTION Which label best describes why the customer called? POSSIBLE ANSWERS One of a fixed set of purpose labels (e.g., billing question).
blocks.zh: 呼叫背景的目的 [呼叫记录] 问题 哪一个标签最能说明客户为什么打电话? 可能的回答 固定的一组目的标签之一(如计费问题).

blocks.en: Quality Assurance CONTEXT {call transcript} QUESTION (one per criterion) Does the call satisfy {service-quality criterion}? POSSIBLE ANSWERS Yes | No
blocks.zh: 质量保证背景{呼叫记录}问题(每个标准一个) 电话是否符合{服务质量标准}? 可能的回答 是 | 否

blocks.en: Procedural Step CONTEXT {call transcript} QUESTION (one per step) Did the agent carry out {procedural step, e.g., verifying the caller’s identity}? POSSIBLE ANSWERS Yes | No
blocks.zh: 程序性步骤背景 问题(每步一个) 代理人是否采取了{程序步骤,例如核实打电话者的身份}? 可能的回答 是 | 否

blocks.en: Intent CONTEXT {customer utterance} QUESTION Which configured intent best matches the customer’s request? POSSIBLE ANSWERS (4--21 per sample) {intent}: {description} | … | no intent
blocks.zh: 意图背景 {顾客口供} 问题 哪些配置的意向最符合客户的要求? 可能的答案( 每个样本4- 21) {意向} : {描述} } {... } } 无意图 。

blocks.en: RAG Document CONTEXT {conversation}; {article 1}, {article 2}, {article 3} QUESTION Which article answers the customer’s last question? POSSIBLE ANSWERS 1 | 2 | 3 | − 1 -1 (none relevant)
blocks.zh: RAG 文档背景 { conversation};{第1条},{第2条},{article 问题 哪篇文章回答了顾客最后的问题? 可能的回答 1 | 2 | 3 | − 1 - 1(无相关)

blocks.en: Agent Workflow Judge CONTEXT {agent instructions and policies}; {conversation and tool-call log} QUESTIONS Was the customer’s task completed? Did the agent claim an action it did not perform? Rate {criterion} from 1 to 5 (five criteria). POSSIBLE ANSWERS success | failure | partial | appropriately transferred | appropriately out of scope; yes | no; 1--5
blocks.zh: 代理工作流程法官 CAURXT {代理指令和政策};{对话与工具呼叫日志} 问题 客户的任务完成了吗? 特工声称没有采取行动吗? 比率 {标准} 从 1 到 5( 五项标准) 。 可能的答案 成功 成功 失败 部分失败 适当转让 适当脱离范围 有效 否; 1-5

blocks.en: Generated Resp. Judge: pointwise CONTEXT {generation instruction and call transcript}; {candidate response} QUESTIONS Rate the response from 1 to 5 for faithfulness, completeness, and instruction following. POSSIBLE ANSWERS (per question) 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5
blocks.zh: 生成Resp. 法官:指向ContactXT {生成指令和呼叫记录};{通知答复} 问题 将答复从1比5评为忠诚、完整性和以下指示。 可能的回答(每个问题)

blocks.en: Generated Resp. Judge: pairwise CONTEXT {generation instruction and call transcript}; {response A}; {response B} (both orders) QUESTION Which response is better? POSSIBLE ANSWERS A | B | tie | both bad
blocks.zh: 生成Resp. 法官:双向CorseXT{生成指令和呼叫记录};{答复A};{答复B}(两项命令) 问题 哪个反应更好? 可能的回答 A \ B \ \ \ \ \ \ 都不好

blocks.en: Output instruction for generative LLMs Return one JSON object that maps each question to one of its allowed answers.
blocks.zh: 对基因LLMs输出指令 返回一个JSON对象,将每个问题映射到它允许的答案之一.
